title: Durand's birthplace and first lessons from his uncle and Professor Humphrey
summary: Durand gives his name, address and birth in 1893 below New Orleans. His uncle in the Terminal Brass Band gave his first lesson, then he studied with Jim Humphrey.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Tell who it is speaking. This is Maurice Durand speaking. Should I tell him my address? Yes. 2281A Sutter Street, San Francisco. I'm from New Orleans, and I born July the 4th, 1893, St. Menard Parish. Down below the city limits? Yes, below the city limits. And I first started to play music when I was about 10, 12 years old. My uncle was a musician. He used to play with the Terminal Brass Band. Which band is that? Terminal.
Terminal Brass Band, yeah. And he gave me my first lesson. And then after that, I was taking lessons from Professor Humphrey.
